results.title: Amon-Ra St. Brown, Jahmyr Gibbs off injury report, will play in Week 8
'I want to build fielding as an attacking weapon': New Mumbai Indians fielding coach T Dilip
results.description: Newly appointed Mumbai Indians fielding coach T Dilip wants to make fielding one of the team's biggest strengths. He believes that a strong fielding unit can change the course of a match and wants to build a culture based on trust, respect and enjoyment. Dilip, who has previously worked as India's fielding coach, was one of three new members of the Mumbai Indians support staff announced on Friday.

results.title: Nuggets’ core survived a tenuous offseason. Will it survive NBA trade deadline if struggles continue?
results.description: Josh Kroenke implied last offseason the Nuggets could trade even Jamal Murray or Aaron Gordon. They didn’t. That doesn’t mean the core is safe, especially if Denver’s uninspiring start to the season continues.

results.description: Kansas State’s season has followed its rushing total. Colorado’s has followed its turnovers. Both trends meet Saturday at Folsom Field, with the Wildcats down to a backup quarterback.
